main.description: Microsoft 365 OAuth code-flow callback receiver. CF Worker on kaisya.gftd.ai exchanges authorization code for ID/access token, resolves UPN → member DID, mints kaisya session JWT (8h TTL), redirects to /chat.

code.description: OAuth authorization code from M365 redirect

state.description: Anti-CSRF state token, validated against session cookie

session_jwt.description: ES256 session JWT, sub=member_did, aud=kaisya, iat/exp set

redirect_to.description: URL to redirect browser after callback
